[EN] We don't even know what we're up against yet—other than this storm.
[ES] Ni siquiera sabemos contra qué nos enfrentamos todavía, aparte de esta tormenta.

[EN] Listen up if you want to live.
[ES] Escucha bien si quieres vivir.

[EN] We can overcome this. We are Valkyon soldiers!
[ES] Podemos superar esto. ¡Somos soldados de la Valkyon!
